clause: Universal profile-tagging law (no untagged device triple) [STU-COL-032]

scope.summary: Every color-bearing value across all Studio primitives (StudioSwatch, StudioGradient stops, StudioPattern colors, text fill/stroke, paragraph decoration, adjustments) MUST carry a StudioColorProfile reference; the conversion boundary is the API decode step per [STU-DOC-003], and a value MUST NOT be stored as an untagged device triple. Implement the decode-boundary tagging + a validation guard that rejects untagged color values.
acceptance_criteria: every color-bearing value carries StudioColorProfile; decode-boundary conversion; untagged rejected + validated
expected_tests: test: swatch/gradient-stop/pattern/text/para-decoration/adjustment color values all carry StudioColorProfile
negative: untagged device triple rejected at decode + flagged by validation descriptor

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Headless/backend MT: no operator-visible surface changed.

user_manual_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Non-product-behavior or internal-scaffold MT; UserManual updated by the consuming feature MT.

risk_if_missed: Untagged device colors leak into authority; color-management pipeline bypassed.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
